name: Strategy 6
description: Foundation-Zone gate on Strategy 2 rules (5-minute): every Foundation SETUP is carded against a memory of price bands (protected levels and cluster sits) and gated TAKE / WATCH / BLOCK; re-entry only after a confirmed leave of the band. Fills, stop and exits as Strategy 2; REENTER adds a band-reclaim exit.
